# Kotiaivot

A tiny brain — the fixture for skills (spec/85): two procedures, one
depending on the other, one driving a tool, a knowledge page that shares
their words without being a skill, a playbook — a how-to for the host,
which is not a skill either — and one convention: a standing rule that
applies before any of it.
